A Floating UI configuration object, or a function that receives the
default configuration and returns a modified one, used to customize the
positioning of the tooltip. [Read more](https://floating-ui.com/docs/computePosition#options)

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset of the tooltip relative to its target.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Describes the placement of your component after the Floating UI middleware may have flipped or altered the originally provided placement property.

`start` and `end` are logical: they follow the reading direction, so `end` is the right side
in LTR and the left side in RTL. `left` and `right` are their deprecated spellings and
resolve identically.

props.name: show
props.description:
Control the visibility. When set, the tooltip renders what `show` says (delays still apply
as presentation) and trigger gestures only emit `update:show` — nothing changes until the
parent flips the prop.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Sets which event handlers you’d like provided to your toggle prop. You can specify one trigger or an array of them.

props.name: visible
props.description: Toggle the visibility of tooltip component.
props.deprecated:
6.0.0 Use `show` / `v-model:show` instead — `visible` is ignored when `show`
is set.

events.name: hidden
events.description: Callback fired when the tooltip has finished its exit transition.

events.name: hide
events.description: Callback fired when the tooltip starts hiding.

events.name: show
events.description: Callback fired when the tooltip starts showing.

events.name: shown
events.description: Callback fired when the tooltip has finished its entry transition.

events.name: update:show
events.description:
Callback fired when the tooltip requests a visibility change — a trigger gesture (hover,
focus, click), the Escape key or any internal toggle. In controlled
mode update `show` yourself, or the tooltip stays as it is.

props.name: ariaMoveAllToSourceLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that moves every visible, enabled option back to the source list.

props.name: ariaMoveAllToTargetLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that moves every visible, enabled option to the target list.

props.name: ariaMovedAnnouncement
props.description: What is announced after a move. `{count}` is how many options moved, `{title}` the destination's title, and both are replaced wherever they appear.

props.name: ariaMoveToSourceLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that moves the selection back to the source list.

props.name: ariaMoveToTargetLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the button that moves the selection to the target list.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values that start in the target list, when the value is not controlled through `value`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the whole transfer off: both list boxes, both search fields and every move button.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Passed to both list boxes. `'none'` drops the checkbox in front of every option.

props.name: items
props.description: The options the transfer moves around. Each entry is passed to the `item` slot, which renders the contents of its option.

props.name: loading
props.description: Covers the wait of one list or of both: a loading list is marked `aria-busy` and shows a row with a spinner and `loadingLabel` below its options, which stay usable. Pass a boolean for both lists, or `{ source, target }` for one of them.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Text of the loading row below the options, announced to screen readers when the shown list starts loading or the list shows up loading.

props.name: oneWay
props.description: Takes the return trip away: both buttons that move back are hidden and a value that has been chosen stays chosen.

props.name: search
props.description: Passed to both list boxes: puts a search field above each list, hiding the options that do not match — so the arrows skip them, the counter drops them and the select-all button takes only what is left on screen. With `'external'` nothing is hidden here: every keystroke is reported through the `search` event and the answer arrives as new `items`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Passed to both list boxes: the placeholder of their search fields, and the first half of their accessible name.

props.name: selectedLabel
props.description:
Passed to both list boxes as their header count text. A function `(count, total) => string`,
or a string in which `{count}` and `{total}` are replaced.

props.name: sourceTitle
props.description: Title of the source list: the label of its select-all button and its accessible name.

props.name: targetTitle
props.description: Title of the target list.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Passed to both list boxes: move the highlight to the option matching what the user types.

props.name: value
props.description: The values in the target list. When set, the component renders that value and only reports the moves through the `change` event. Supports the `v-model:value` binding.

events.name: change
events.description: Callback fired after options moved between the lists.

properties.name: change
properties.description: `{ direction, moved }` — which list was filled and the values that moved into it.

events.name: search
events.description: Callback fired when a search field changes. In the `'external'` search mode it is the only report the component makes — nothing is filtered here.

properties.name: side
properties.description: `'source'` or `'target'` — the list the query was typed in.

events.name: update:value
events.description: Emit the values of the target list to support the `v-model:value` binding.

props.name: visibleItems
props.description: Amount of visible items
